tha-ap385:1.1: samattaṃ. [380. Udumbaraphaladāyaka.] Vinatānadiyā tīre vihāsi purisuttamo / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddham ekaggaṃ susamāhitaṃ // //
tha-ap385:2.1: Tasmiṃ pasannamānaso kilesamaladhovane / udumbaraṃ phalaṃ gayha Buddhaseṭṭhass' adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap385:3.1: Ekanavut' ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap385:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Udumbaraphaladāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
